verdict.rationale: LocalAI documents a built-in agent platform with MCP tool support, but nothing in the evidence shows automations that run autonomously in the background. There is no scheduling, triggers, recurring jobs, or unattended execution. The documented `local-ai chat` agent is interactive and gates state-changing actions behind user approval, so agent creation is only adjacent to this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
